notes.title: Greetings Grumpy Witches!
notes.notes:
Greetings and Salutations Grumpy Witches!

Just a quick update here now that Grumpy Witch is available for you to wishlist,

Firstly, we'd like to point you to a few external sources of information outside Steam that will help you keep up with the game and it's development as well as interact with the dev team.

[b]Twitter:[/b] https://twitter.com/pixelconstructr - @pixelconstructr

[b]Facebook:[/b] https://www.facebook.com/grumpywitchgame/ - @grumpywitchgame

[b]Tumblr:[/b] http://pixelconstructor.tumblr.com/

[b]Twitch.tv: [/b] https://www.twitch.tv/pixelconstructor

[b]Discord: [/b]https://discord.gg/M45dNCm 

That should just about cover it for now, so please feel free to come join us across all our social media to keep up with Grumpy Witch as we move ever closer to release.

Secondly,

We'll be putting out Weekly Dev Blogs that will range from an over view of a certain topic, to an update on the status of development and all the way to studies and overviews of the history of platforming video games! The blog will go up on our official website first, located here: http://www.pixelconstructor.com/ (Click the Blog Link in the top right corner.) and then go out to the rest of our social media and steam shortly after.

We'll see you out and about Grumpy Witches!

Ciara Rayne K.
Pixel Constructor
Community Manager
